empires.name: Central Empire (Aether)
empires.description: A vast governing nation where the Emperor and Princesses hold absolute power. Its capital is Grandel.
empires.military: The Imperial Army directly under the Emperor (Knight Orders, Magic Corps) and noble private soldiers in charge of territorial defense.

nations.name: Eastern Holy Nation (Lumina)
nations.description: A religious nation whose state religion is the Church of Lily.
nations.stance: Proclaims political neutrality and pursues an ideology of rewarding good and punishing evil.
nations.light_and_shadow: The Holy Sword Excalibur exists, but internally there are also those who are corrupt.

organizations.name: Information Guild Tenebris
organizations.description: A vast underground crime/information cartel that evolved from former imperial intelligence operatives. ('The truth is more expensive than blood')

organizations.name: Demon Realm Legions
organizations.description: Strict vertical hierarchy based on magical talent and power.

legions.name: 1st Legion (Iris)
legions.description: An elusive, corrupted region of the Demon Realm shrouded in a deceptive gray mist, where mental erosion is lethal.

legions.name: 2nd Legion (Kashar)
legions.description: An endless wasteland battered by red sandstorms and a vast ruined city. A cruel arena where only strength proves rank, and a cynically defiant sanctuary that takes in the outcasts of the Demon Realm.

legions.name: 3rd Legion (Lilith)
legions.description: A decadent gothic castle and a dreamlike ball.

legions.name: 4th Legion (Unknown)
legions.description: A place where extreme killing intent and formless sword energy rage.
legions.hidden: Its commander is Kriemhild, the Sword Saint, bound to the Demon King by a soul-bond. Publicly, nobody knows who leads it.

organizations.hierarchy: Demon King > Legion Commander > Officer > Monster class
